E  NOTE  14.02.2024 I.A.No.21 of 2024 in W.P. No.10547 of 2006  This application is filed seeking to implead  Sri Seetharama Anjaneya Swamy Vari Temple  (represented by Executive Officer)
 Pothereddypalem Village, Machilipatnam  Mandal, Krishna District as party respondent No.43 in the writ petition.
We have gone through the application and also heard the learned counsel for the parties.
Learned counsel for the non-applicants reported no objection.
For the reasons stated in the accompanying affidavit filed in support of the petition, this application is allowed and the proposed party shall be impleaded as respondent No.43 in the Writ Petition and other miscellaneous applications.

I.A.No.18 of 2024 in W.P. No.10547 of 2006 This application filed seeking to implead Sri Chennakesava Swamy Temple as also Sri Virupaksheswara Swamy Temple as party respondent Nos.46 and 47 in the present writ petition is allowed.

W.P. Nos.10547, 10581 and 24177 of 2006 & 13545 of 2017 Notices be issued for service upon newly added respondent Nos.43 to 45 in W.P.No.10547 of 2006.
Personal notice on the said respondents is also permitted.
Registry is directed to reflect the name of Mr. M. Srinivas, in the cause list as learned counsel for the respondent Nos.46 and 47 in W.P.No.10547 of 2006.
I.A. No.22 of 2024 in W.P. No.10547 of 2006

The present application has been filed seeking permission of this Court in terms of the directions issued earlier on 30.05.2006 in W.P.M.P.
No.13204 of 2006 in W.P. No.10547 of 2006.

As per the aforementioned order, the Court had directed that pending further orders, all further proceedings in relation to the acquisition of lands belonging to the temples all over the State at whatever stage they may be, shall remain stayed.

Subsequently, by virtue of order dated 11.09.2007, a Division Bench of this Court had modified the directions dated 30.05.2006 and permitted the acquisition of Acs.17.32 cents belonging to 11 temples specified in W.P.M.P. No.15330 of 2007 in W.P. No.10547 of 2006, which was otherwise required for completion of an irrigation project.

On similar lines, the present application has been filed seeking permission of this Court and modification of the order, dated 30.05.2006, for purposes of providing road and rail connectivity to the Machilipatnam port.

The details of the land measuring approximately Ac.5.36 cents belonging to Sri Sitarama Anjaneya Swamy vari Temple, Pothepalli, Machilipatnam, are given hereunder:
Name of Surve Total Area Name of & address S. the village y No. extent under of person No. Acquisitio n on (in interested acre) 1 Pothepalli 248 23.85 4.63
Sree Seeta Ramanjaneya Swamy Varu 2 Pothepalli 248 23..85 0.05 Sree Seeta Ramanjaneya Swamy Varu 3 Pothepalli 245-2 0.71 0.68
Sree Seeta Ramanjaneya Swamy Varu
Total 5.36
We have heard learned counsel for the parties.
Learned counsel for respondent No.43 - Sri Sitarama Anjaneya Swamy vari Temple has no objection to the acquisition of the endowments land.
The land is being acquired for providing road connectivity to the Machilipatnam port, which is in the public interest.

We, therefore, permit the acquisition of subject lands and direct that the compensation for the said pieces of land shall no way be less than the compensation, which may be fixed on account of acquisition of contiguous lands belonging to private/other parties in regard to the notification, dated 31.12.2022 and in case, the landholders whose lands have been acquired under the said notification are not satisfied with the compensation awarded as per the Award and prefer an appeal, then the benefit of enhancement of the compensation shall also be given to the temple in regard to the subject land.
Notwithstanding the observation/direction hereinabove, it shall be open to the temple or any devotee on behalf of the temple, to independently prefer an appeal seeking higher compensation in appeal proceedings under Section 64 of the Act, 2013.
The interlocutory application is, accordingly, disposed of.
W.P. Nos.10547, 10581 and 24177 of 2006 List on 21.02.2024.
